cli: --runtime-lpm-layout PATH; absent by default, ignored in proof mode
implementation: Shared generic-lookup call routine checks actual map_type and live data_size. LPM12data bytes uses64+32bit big-endian XOR/BSR with short-prefix early exit, full match before intermediate-node flags, previous best fallback, RCU child traversal and data+12 value return. Other types/sizes call original helper with original args/SysV stack alignment; no name-based inference, SIMD or node-count limit.

tests.reference: Independent bit-at-a-time C lookup on64 compressed synthetic tries, node layout deliberately differs from kernel;65590 real emitted-code cases include short/invalid prefixes, intermediate/full-depth nodes, unaligned/guard-end keys, live root replacement and generic-helper ABI.

scope: Host semantics and real-object CLI/default parity only. No LPM kernel execution, whole-app installation, throughput or equal-work certification. Running read/hash jobs keep older immutable payloads.
